visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A round2 Helper
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The same rounding formula is written out three times. Move it into a round2 function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A named helper says what the formula is for, and a change to how rounding works (for example a different number of decimals) is made in one place. Note that 1.005 prints 1, not 1.01, because the stored value of 1.005 is slightly below 1.005.
